cases.note: An exact claim id puts that claim first, ahead of the section that only cites it.
A source id lists every version in natural order, v1 then v2 then v10, ahead of the section that cites it, whatever each version scores.
A bare 7012 reaches the clause card through the alias added when 252.204-7012 is indexed, and its title hit outranks the body hit of the flow-down section.
252.204 reaches every unit that holds a longer 252.204 clause number through the ancestor token, and the exact ancestor impact beats half the impact of the longer number.
Only the last token is a prefix: withhold also reaches withholding at half its impact by integer division, while payment, which is not last, does not reach payments.
A unit that matches both tokens ranks above units that match one token, even when its summed impact is lower.
The same token in a title, in a heading and in a body ranks the title hit first and the body hit last.
A glossary alias lets ice find a section that only says independent cost estimate, ranked below the page that has ice literally in its id and title.
A section id is in the exact class, so it ranks first with matched 0 and sum 0, ahead of units that score on the tokens cmp and cdi.
A query made only of punctuation and symbols, including a dash that folds to a hyphen, has no tokens and returns an empty list.
